# ElliottDB v1.0.0 — Complete Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Single-binary, zero-dependency, high-concurrency relational database written in C11 for Linux and Windows.
> Repository: https://github.com/elliott964/ElliottDB
> Live Docs: https://elliott964.github.io/ElliottDB/

## Quick Start
1. Run `elliottdb` (Linux) or `elliottdb.exe` (Windows) — zero configuration required.
2. Connect via CLI (`elliottdb cli`), HTTP/1.1 JSON (`http://127.0.0.1:7432/query`), Binary (`EDB1`), or Text SQL on port `7432`.
3. Generate config template: `elliottdb init-config elliottdb.conf`.
4. Run built-in benchmarks: `elliottdb bench --workload ping -c 64 -t 8 -n 200000 --pipeline 32`.

## Verified Windows Benchmarks (MSVC /O2 /MT, 8 threads)
- Embedded `point` (200,000 reqs): 493,907 req/s | p50=6us p95=10us p99=76us
- TCP IOCP `ping` (200,000 reqs, 64 clients, pipeline 32): 466,944 req/s | p50=11us p95=26us p99=59us
- TCP IOCP `read` (100,000 reqs, 64 clients, pipeline 16): 171,326 req/s | p50=33us p95=91us p99=193us
- TCP IOCP `mixed` (50,000 reqs, 64 clients, pipeline 16): 112,176 req/s | p50=54us p95=140us p99=225us

## Complete SQL Reference
- DDL: `CREATE TABLE [IF NOT EXISTS] t (col INT|REAL|TEXT|BOOL|BLOB|TIMESTAMP [PRIMARY KEY] [AUTO_INCREMENT] [NOT NULL] [UNIQUE] [DEFAULT v])`, `DROP TABLE [IF EXISTS] t`, `ALTER TABLE t ADD [COLUMN] coldef`, `CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX [IF NOT EXISTS] idx ON t (col) [USING BTREE|HASH]`, `DROP INDEX [IF EXISTS] idx`.
- DML: `INSERT INTO t [(cols)] VALUES (...), (...)`, `UPDATE t SET c=expr [WHERE ...]`, `DELETE FROM t [WHERE ...]`.
- Queries: `SELECT [DISTINCT] items FROM t [AS a] [INNER|LEFT|RIGHT|CROSS JOIN t2 [AS b] ON expr] [WHERE expr] [GROUP BY exprs] [HAVING expr] [ORDER BY expr [ASC|DESC]] [LIMIT n [OFFSET m]]`.
- Expressions & Functions: arithmetic (`+ - * / %`), concat (`||`), comparisons (`= != <> < <= > >=`), `IS [NOT] NULL`, `[NOT] IN (...)`, `[NOT] BETWEEN a AND b`, `[NOT] LIKE pat`, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END`, `COUNT(*|col|DISTINCT col)`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`, `LOWER`, `UPPER`, `LENGTH`, `COALESCE`, `ABS`, `NOW`, `ROUND`, `SUBSTR`.
- Transactions & Prepared: `BEGIN [TRANSACTION]`, `COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK`, `PREPARE name AS sql`, `EXECUTE name(args...)`, `DEALLOCATE name`.
- Introspection & Admin: `EXPLAIN <stmt>`, `SHOW TABLES`, `DESCRIBE <table>`, `SHOW CONFIG [LIKE 'pat']`, `SHOW STATS`, `SET section.key = value`, `CHECKPOINT`, `VACUUM`, `PING`.

## All 92 Configuration Parameters

### [server] (8 options)
- `server.host` (`string`, default=`0.0.0.0`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_HOST`): Bind IP address (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
- `server.port` (`int`, default=`7432` [range 1..65535], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_PORT`): Primary TCP port (multiplexes Binary, HTTP/JSON, and Text protocols)
- `server.http_port` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..65535], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_HTTP_PORT`): Optional dedicated HTTP port (0 = multiplexed on main port)
- `server.node_name` (`string`, default=`elliottdb-1`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_NODE_NAME`): Logical node identifier
- `server.pid_file` (`string`, default=``, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_PID_FILE`): Optional PID file path
- `server.shutdown_timeout_ms` (`int`, default=`5000` [range 100..300000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS`): Graceful shutdown drain timeout in ms
- `server.banner_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_BANNER_ENABLED`): Print startup banner
- `server.daemonize` (`bool`, default=`false`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_DAEMONIZE`): Run as background daemon (Linux)

### [network] (20 options)
- `network.max_connections` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..100000000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_MAX_CONNECTIONS`): Max concurrent connections (0 = unlimited dynamically growing slab)
- `network.listen_backlog` (`int`, default=`65535` [range 16..1048576], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_LISTEN_BACKLOG`): TCP listen backlog
- `network.io_threads` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..256], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_IO_THREADS`): Reactor I/O threads (0 = auto)
- `network.tcp_nodelay` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_TCP_NODELAY`): Disable Nagle's algorithm for low latency
- `network.tcp_keepalive` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_TCP_KEEPALIVE`): Enable TCP keepalive probes
- `network.keepalive_idle_sec` (`int`, default=`60` [range 1..86400], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_KEEPALIVE_IDLE_SEC`): TCP keepalive idle seconds
- `network.keepalive_interval_sec` (`int`, default=`10` [range 1..3600], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL_SEC`): TCP keepalive probe interval seconds
- `network.socket_recv_buf_kb` (`int`, default=`256` [range 0..65536], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_SOCKET_RECV_BUF_KB`): SO_RCVBUF size in KB (0 = OS default)
- `network.socket_send_buf_kb` (`int`, default=`256` [range 0..65536], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_SOCKET_SEND_BUF_KB`): SO_SNDBUF size in KB (0 = OS default)
- `network.read_buf_initial_kb` (`int`, default=`8` [range 1..4096], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_READ_BUF_INITIAL_KB`): Initial per-connection read buffer in KB
- `network.read_buf_max_mb` (`int`, default=`64` [range 1..1024], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_READ_BUF_MAX_MB`): Maximum per-connection read buffer in MB
- `network.write_buf_initial_kb` (`int`, default=`16` [range 1..4096], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_WRITE_BUF_INITIAL_KB`): Initial per-connection write buffer in KB
- `network.idle_timeout_sec` (`int`, default=`300` [range 0..864000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC`): Close idle connections after N seconds (0 = disabled)
- `network.request_timeout_ms` (`int`, default=`30000` [range 0..3600000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`): Request execution timeout in ms
- `network.max_pipeline_depth` (`int`, default=`1024` [range 1..65536], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_MAX_PIPELINE_DEPTH`): Max pipelined frames processed per connection batch
- `network.max_query_size_mb` (`int`, default=`16` [range 1..512], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_MAX_QUERY_SIZE_MB`): Maximum SQL query payload in MB
- `network.enable_http` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_ENABLE_HTTP`): Enable HTTP/1.1 JSON API
- `network.enable_binary_protocol` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_ENABLE_BINARY_PROTOCOL`): Enable high-speed EDB1 binary protocol
- `network.enable_text_protocol` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_ENABLE_TEXT_PROTOCOL`): Enable text line SQL protocol
- `network.reuse_port` (`bool`, default=`true`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_NETWORK_REUSE_PORT`): Enable SO_REUSEPORT on Linux

### [concurrency] (10 options)
- `concurrency.worker_threads` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..1024], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_WORKER_THREADS`): Query worker threads (0 = auto CPU count)
- `concurrency.queue_capacity` (`int`, default=`65536` [range 64..16777216], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_QUEUE_CAPACITY`): Total request queue capacity across shards
- `concurrency.queue_shards` (`int`, default=`16` [range 1..256], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_QUEUE_SHARDS`): Number of work queue shards (power of 2 recommended)
- `concurrency.lock_stripes` (`int`, default=`64` [range 1..1024], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_LOCK_STRIPES`): Lock stripe count for sharded subsystems
- `concurrency.spin_count` (`int`, default=`4000` [range 0..100000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_SPIN_COUNT`): Spin count before sleeping
- `concurrency.batch_dispatch_size` (`int`, default=`64` [range 1..4096], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_BATCH_DISPATCH_SIZE`): Batch size for queue dispatch
- `concurrency.max_concurrent_writers` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..1024], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_MAX_CONCURRENT_WRITERS`): Max concurrent writers (0 = auto)
- `concurrency.overload_policy` (`string`, default=`queue`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_OVERLOAD_POLICY`): Overload handling: queue | shed | backpressure
- `concurrency.max_queue_wait_ms` (`int`, default=`5000` [range 1..600000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_MAX_QUEUE_WAIT_MS`): Max time a request waits in queue
- `concurrency.conn_slab_chunk` (`int`, default=`1024` [range 64..65536], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_CONCURRENCY_CONN_SLAB_CHUNK`): Connections allocated per slab chunk

### [storage] (9 options)
- `storage.data_dir` (`string`, default=`./elliottdb_data`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_DATA_DIR`): Database data directory
- `storage.db_filename` (`string`, default=`elliottdb.edb`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_DB_FILENAME`): Primary database file name
- `storage.page_size` (`int`, default=`8192` [range 4096..65536], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_PAGE_SIZE`): Page size in bytes (power of 2: 4096..65536)
- `storage.in_memory` (`bool`, default=`false`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_IN_MEMORY`): Run purely in memory with no disk persistence
- `storage.auto_create_dir` (`bool`, default=`true`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_AUTO_CREATE_DIR`): Automatically create data directory
- `storage.preallocate_mb` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..1048576], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_PREALLOCATE_MB`): Preallocate database file size in MB
- `storage.fill_factor` (`int`, default=`90` [range 50..100], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_FILL_FACTOR`): Target page fill factor percentage
- `storage.compact_threshold_pct` (`int`, default=`30` [range 5..90], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_COMPACT_THRESHOLD_PCT`): Dead-space percentage triggering page compaction
- `storage.max_db_size_gb` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..1048576], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_STORAGE_MAX_DB_SIZE_GB`): Maximum database size in GB (0 = unlimited)

### [buffer_pool] (6 options)
- `buffer_pool.size_mb` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..1048576], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_SIZE_MB`): Buffer pool memory in MB (0 = auto 25% RAM, min 32MB, max 2048MB)
- `buffer_pool.shards` (`int`, default=`64` [range 1..256], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_SHARDS`): Buffer pool partition shards (power of 2)
- `buffer_pool.eviction_policy` (`string`, default=`clock`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_EVICTION_POLICY`): Eviction policy: clock | lru
- `buffer_pool.dirty_flush_pct` (`int`, default=`75` [range 10..100], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_DIRTY_FLUSH_PCT`): Dirty page threshold percentage
- `buffer_pool.bg_flush_interval_ms` (`int`, default=`1000` [range 50..60000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_BG_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS`): Background flush interval in ms
- `buffer_pool.prefetch_pages` (`int`, default=`4` [range 0..128], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_BUFFER_POOL_PREFETCH_PAGES`): Sequential scan prefetch pages

### [wal] (10 options)
- `wal.enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_ENABLED`): Enable Write-Ahead Logging
- `wal.dir` (`string`, default=``, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_DIR`): WAL directory (empty = same as data_dir)
- `wal.sync_mode` (`string`, default=`normal`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_SYNC_MODE`): Durability mode: off | normal | full
- `wal.group_commit_ms` (`int`, default=`1` [range 0..1000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_GROUP_COMMIT_MS`): Group commit coalescing window in ms
- `wal.group_commit_max_ops` (`int`, default=`1024` [range 1..65536], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_GROUP_COMMIT_MAX_OPS`): Max operations per group commit batch
- `wal.segment_size_mb` (`int`, default=`64` [range 1..4096], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_SEGMENT_SIZE_MB`): WAL segment rotation size in MB
- `wal.checkpoint_interval_sec` (`int`, default=`60` [range 1..86400], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_SEC`): Automatic checkpoint interval in seconds
- `wal.checkpoint_wal_mb` (`int`, default=`32` [range 1..16384], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_CHECKPOINT_WAL_MB`): Trigger checkpoint when WAL exceeds N MB
- `wal.checksum_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_CHECKSUM_ENABLED`): Verify CRC32C checksums on WAL records
- `wal.recovery_mode` (`string`, default=`strict`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_WAL_RECOVERY_MODE`): WAL recovery mode: strict | lenient

### [query] (11 options)
- `query.plan_cache_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_PLAN_CACHE_ENABLED`): Enable sharded parsed SQL plan cache
- `query.plan_cache_entries` (`int`, default=`4096` [range 0..1000000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_PLAN_CACHE_ENTRIES`): Max cached SQL plans
- `query.result_cache_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_RESULT_CACHE_ENABLED`): Enable sharded query result cache
- `query.result_cache_mb` (`int`, default=`64` [range 0..65536], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_RESULT_CACHE_MB`): Max result cache memory in MB
- `query.result_cache_ttl_ms` (`int`, default=`5000` [range 0..3600000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_RESULT_CACHE_TTL_MS`): Result cache entry TTL in ms
- `query.max_rows_returned` (`int`, default=`1000000` [range 0..100000000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_MAX_ROWS_RETURNED`): Safety cap on rows returned per query (0 = unlimited)
- `query.default_limit` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..10000000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_DEFAULT_LIMIT`): Default SELECT LIMIT if omitted (0 = none)
- `query.work_mem_mb` (`int`, default=`16` [range 1..16384], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_WORK_MEM_MB`): Per-query sort/hash work memory in MB
- `query.hash_join_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_HASH_JOIN_ENABLED`): Use hash join for equi-joins
- `query.index_scan_enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_INDEX_SCAN_ENABLED`): Use B+Tree/Hash indexes for WHERE predicates
- `query.slow_query_ms` (`int`, default=`100` [range 0..3600000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_QUERY_SLOW_QUERY_MS`): Slow query threshold in ms

### [index] (4 options)
- `index.btree_order` (`int`, default=`64` [range 8..512], restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_INDEX_BTREE_ORDER`): B+Tree branching order
- `index.auto_index_pk` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_INDEX_AUTO_INDEX_PK`): Automatically create index on PRIMARY KEY
- `index.default_index_type` (`string`, default=`btree`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_INDEX_DEFAULT_INDEX_TYPE`): Default index type: btree | hash
- `index.hash_load_factor` (`int`, default=`75` [range 25..95], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_INDEX_HASH_LOAD_FACTOR`): Hash index resize load factor percentage

### [security] (6 options)
- `security.auth_enabled` (`bool`, default=`false`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_AUTH_ENABLED`): Require authentication on connections
- `security.admin_user` (`string`, default=`admin`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER`): Default admin username
- `security.admin_password` (`string`, default=``, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD`): Admin password when auth_enabled=true
- `security.read_only` (`bool`, default=`false`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_READ_ONLY`): Reject all write/DDL queries
- `security.max_auth_failures` (`int`, default=`5` [range 1..1000], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_MAX_AUTH_FAILURES`): Disconnect after N failed auth attempts
- `security.allowed_hosts` (`string`, default=`*`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_SECURITY_ALLOWED_HOSTS`): Allowed host pattern (* for any)

### [logging] (5 options)
- `logging.level` (`string`, default=`info`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_LOGGING_LEVEL`): Log level: trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal
- `logging.file` (`string`, default=``, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_LOGGING_FILE`): Log file path (empty = stderr)
- `logging.format` (`string`, default=`text`, restart-required, env=`ELLIOTTDB_LOGGING_FORMAT`): Log format: text | json
- `logging.log_queries` (`bool`, default=`false`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_LOGGING_LOG_QUERIES`): Log every executed SQL query
- `logging.log_slow_queries` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_LOGGING_LOG_SLOW_QUERIES`): Log queries slower than slow_query_ms

### [metrics] (3 options)
- `metrics.enabled` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_METRICS_ENABLED`): Collect atomic runtime metrics
- `metrics.interval_sec` (`int`, default=`0` [range 0..86400], runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_METRICS_INTERVAL_SEC`): Periodic metrics log interval in sec (0 = disabled)
- `metrics.track_latency` (`bool`, default=`true`, runtime-mutable, env=`ELLIOTTDB_METRICS_TRACK_LATENCY`): Track microsecond latency histogram

## Compact Agent Reference (AGENTS-LITE.md)

# AGENTS-LITE.md — ElliottDB Compact Agent Spec (v1.0.0)

**Identity**: Single-binary, zero-dep C11 RDBMS. Targets: `build\elliottdb.exe` (Win x64 `/MT`, `WS2_32`+`KERNEL32` only) & `build/elliottdb` (Linux x64 `pthread`+`lm`). Default port `7432` multiplexes Binary `EDB1`, HTTP/1.1 JSON, and Text SQL. Zero warnings under MSVC `/W4` & GCC `-Wall -Wextra`.

## Code Map (`src/`)
- `edb_common.h`, `edb_util.c`: `edb_status_t` (0..12), `edb_buf_t`, `edb_arena_t` (64KB blocks), `edb_crc32c`, `edb_hash64`, `edb_like_match`, text/JSON logger.
- `pal.h`, `pal_win.c`, `pal_linux.c`: atomics (`edb_atomic_*`), mutex/rwlock/cond/thread, `pread`/`pwrite`, signals, TCP helpers.
- `config.h`, `config.c`, `metrics.h`, `metrics.c`: 92 config keys (11 sections), INI/env/CLI/runtime `SET`, atomic counters + 16-bucket us latency histogram.
- `pager.h`, `pager.c`, `wal.h`, `wal.c`: 64-shard clock-sweep buffer pool, slotted pages (`rid=(pid<<16)|slot`), CRC32C WAL (`off|normal|full`), group commit, crash replay.
- `index.h`, `index.c`, `storage.h`, `storage.c`: B+Tree (linked leaves, `(key,rid)` tie-break) + Hash index, catalog persistence, per-table `rwlock` + atomic `version`, undo-log txns.
- `sql_ast.h`, `sql_parser.c`, `sql_exec.h`, `sql_exec.c`: lexer/RD-parser, 64-shard plan & versioned result caches, index eq/range scans, Hash Join, `GROUP BY`/`HAVING`, `ORDER BY`, `EXPLAIN`, `PREPARE`/`EXECUTE`.
- `protocol.h`, `protocol.c`: auto-detect `EDB1` / HTTP / Text; `edb_bin_encode_frame`, `edb_bin_decode_response`, Basic Auth.
- `reactor.h`, `reactor_win.c`, `reactor_linux.c`: slab-pooled `edb_conn_t`, Windows IOCP (`WSARecv`/`WSASend`), Linux `EPOLLET`+`SO_REUSEPORT`+`eventfd`.
- `server.h`, `server.c`: sharded work-stealing queues, worker pool, bg flush/checkpoint/reaper thread.
- `cli.c`, `bench.c`, `main.c`: `EDB1` REPL/CLI, TCP+`--embedded` bench, subcommand dispatch (`server|cli|bench|init-config|version|help`).

## Hard Invariants (Do Not Violate)
1. **Win Headers**: Include `<winsock2.h>`/`<ws2tcpip.h>` (via `pal.h`) BEFORE `<windows.h>`. Never use `<stdatomic.h>` or GCC extensions (VLAs/`typeof`). Keep `_GNU_SOURCE` on Linux.
2. **Conn Lifetime**: `refcount=1` on accept; retain for every pending I/O, kick, or worker task; `free_conn_final()` runs at `refcount==0` calling `on_close` before slab recycle.
3. **IOCP Double-Buffer (`reactor_win.c`)**: Workers append to `ctx->tx_buf` under `io_mu`; `try_start_send_locked()` swaps `tx_buf`->`tx_active` only when `!send_pending`. Never `realloc` an in-flight `WSASend` buffer.
4. **Lock Hygiene**: In `alloc_conn()`, initialize `last_active_ms` & `conn` BEFORE linking into `active_head` under `pool_mu`. Never call `close_conn_socket()` while holding `io_mu`—return `bool need_close` and close after unlock.
5. **Worker Queues (`server.c`)**: `conn->worker_busy` enforces 1 worker/conn (FIFO pipeline). `queue_shards <= worker_count`; index with `% queue_shards`. `work_queue_pop()` uses single 5ms `timedwait` (`if`, not `while`) to allow work stealing.
6. **SQL Exec (`sql_exec.c`)**: `group_t` stores full joined `tuples` (`const edb_row_t *const **`); `ORDER BY` checks `projs[p].name` aliases first; `qsort_s`(Win) vs `qsort_r`(Linux) arg order differs.

## Wire Protocols (Port 7432)
- **Detect**: byte[0]==`0x45` -> Binary; `GET |POST|HEAD|PUT |DELE|OPTI` -> HTTP; else -> Text (`\n`-delimited, `AUTH u p`, `QUIT`).
- **Binary `EDB1` (LE)**:
  - Req `[0]='E', [1]=op(1=PING,2=QUERY,3=BATCH,4=AUTH,5=PREPARE,6=EXEC), [2..3]=flags, [4..7]=len` + payload.
  - Resp `[0]='R', [1]=status(0..12), [2..3]=flags(b0=select,b1=cached), [4..7]=len`. Body: `PING`->`"PONG"`; Query->`[u64 aff][u64 last_id][u64 us]`, err? `[u16 elen][err]` : select? `[u32 cols][u32 rows]` + cols `[u16 nl][name][u8 typ]` + cells `[u8 typ][val]`. Types: `0=NULL,1=INT(i64),2=REAL(f64),3=TEXT(u32+b),4=BOOL(u8),5=BLOB(u32+b),6=TS(i64)`.
- **HTTP JSON**: `GET /health`, `GET /metrics`, `GET /config`, `POST /query` (raw SQL or `{"sql":...}`), `POST /batch` (`;`-sep SQL). Basic Auth (`401` except `/health`).

## Config & Commands
- **Precedence**: Defaults < `elliottdb.conf` (`-c`) < `ELLIOTTDB_<SEC>_<KEY>` < `--sec.key=val` (`-H,-p,-d,-t,--memory,--no-banner`) < SQL `SET sec.key=val`.
- **Sections**: `server, network, concurrency, storage, buffer_pool, wal, query, index, security, logging, metrics` (schema: `docs/api/config-schema.json`).
- **Build & Test**:
  - Win: `build.bat` | CMake: `cmake -B build_cmake -G Ninja && cmake --build build_cmake` | Linux: `make` / `./build.sh --static`
  - Test: `python tests\test_suite.py` | Regenerate docs data: `python scripts/gen_docs_data.py`

## Full Agent Reference (AGENTS.md)

# AGENTS.md — ElliottDB Engineering & Integration Handbook

> Authoritative technical reference for AI coding agents working on or integrating with **ElliottDB** (`v1.0.0`).
> For a token-minimal version suitable for system prompts, see [`AGENTS-LITE.md`](AGENTS-LITE.md).

---

## 1. Project Identity & Core Constraints

- **Project**: ElliottDB — single-binary, zero-dependency, high-concurrency relational database in portable **C11**.
- **Release Targets**:
  - Windows x64: `build\elliottdb.exe` (statically linked `/MT`, OS dependencies `WS2_32.dll` + `KERNEL32.dll` only).
  - Linux x64: `build/elliottdb` (GCC/Clang `-std=c11 -O3`, optional `-static`, `pthread` + `lm` only).
- **Zero-Config UX**: Running `./elliottdb` or `elliottdb.exe` with no arguments binds `0.0.0.0:7432`, creates `./elliottdb_data`, auto-tunes worker/I/O threads and buffer pool (25% RAM, clamped 32 MB–2048 MB), and multiplexes **Binary (`EDB1`)**, **HTTP/1.1 JSON**, and **Text Line** protocols on the same TCP port.
- **Compiler Discipline**: Zero warnings under MSVC `/W4` and GCC/Clang `-Wall -Wextra`.

---

## 2. Repository & Codebase Map

| File | Responsibility & Key Symbols |
| :--- | :--- |
| `src/edb_common.h`, `src/edb_util.c` | `edb_status_t` (0..12), `edb_buf_t` dynamic byte buffer, `edb_arena_t` (64 KB chunk bump allocator), `edb_crc32c()`, `edb_hash64()`, `edb_hash_str_ci()`, `edb_like_match()`, `edb_json_append_escaped()`, thread-safe text/JSON logger (`edb_log_*`). |
| `src/pal.h` | OS-agnostic atomics (`edb_atomic_i64/u64/u32`), `edb_mutex_t`, `edb_rwlock_t`, `edb_cond_t`, `edb_thread_t`, `edb_file_t`, `edb_socket_t`, `EDB_INVALID_SOCK`, time/CPU/RAM helpers. |
| `src/pal_win.c` | Windows PAL: `Interlocked*`, `CRITICAL_SECTION`, `SRWLOCK`, `CONDITION_VARIABLE`, `_beginthreadex`, `QueryPerformanceCounter`, `CreateFileA` with `io_mu`-protected `SetFilePointerEx`+`ReadFile`/`WriteFile`, `SetConsoleCtrlHandler`, Winsock2. |
| `src/pal_linux.c` | Linux PAL: `__atomic_*`, `pthread_*`, `clock_gettime`, `pread`/`pwrite`/`fdatasync`, `sigaction` (`SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`, `SIG_IGN` on `SIGPIPE`), POSIX sockets (`TCP_KEEPIDLE`, `SO_REUSEPORT`). |
| `src/config.h`, `src/config.c` | `edb_config_t` & `g_specs[]` (**92** parameters across 11 sections): defaults, INI parser (`elliottdb.conf`), env vars (`ELLIOTTDB_<SECTION>_<KEY>`), CLI args (`--section.key=val`), `edb_config_finalize()`, `edb_config_set_kv()`, `edb_config_write_template()`, `edb_config_dump_json()`. |
| `src/metrics.h`, `src/metrics.c` | Lock-free atomic counters (`active_connections`, `total_requests`, `select_count`, cache hits, WAL/buffer stats) + 16-bucket logarithmic latency histogram (`edb_metrics_percentile_us()`). |
| `src/pager.h`, `src/pager.c` | 64-shard clock-sweep Buffer Pool (`edb_pager_t`), Page 0 `edb_file_header_t`, slotted page header `edb_page_hdr_t`, `edb_rid_t = (page_id << 16) | slot_idx`, pure `in_memory` mode. |
| `src/wal.h`, `src/wal.c` | Append-only WAL (`elliottdb.wal`), `EDB_WAL_MAGIC = 0x45444257`, CRC32C record framing, `off \| normal \| full` sync modes, Group Commit coalescing (`group_commit_ms`, `group_commit_max_ops`), `edb_wal_replay()`. |
| `src/index.h`, `src/index.c` | `edb_val_t` & `edb_val_cmp()`/`edb_val_hash()`, B+Tree (`EDB_IDX_BTREE` with doubly-linked leaves and `(key, rid)` tie-breaker for non-unique keys), open-addressed Hash index (`EDB_IDX_HASH`). |
| `src/storage.h`, `src/storage.c` | `edb_db_t`, `edb_table_t` (per-table `edb_rwlock_t`, atomic `version`), `edb_txn_t` (undo log `UNDO_INSERT`/`DELETE`/`UPDATE`), catalog page serialization, WAL replay filtering uncommitted txns, `edb_db_checkpoint()`. |
| `src/sql_ast.h`, `src/sql_parser.c` | Hand-written lexer & recursive-descent parser allocating AST nodes from `edb_arena_t`. |
| `src/sql_exec.h`, `src/sql_exec.c` | `edb_engine_t` (64-shard plan cache + 64-shard atomic table-version-invalidated result cache), `edb_session_t`, index scan extractor, Hash Join + Nested Loop Join, `GROUP BY`/aggregates/`HAVING`, `ORDER BY`, `EXPLAIN`, `PREPARE`/`EXECUTE`, JSON/ASCII table formatters. |
| `src/protocol.h`, `src/protocol.c` | Multiplexed protocol auto-detection (`PROTO_BINARY`, `PROTO_HTTP`, `PROTO_TEXT`), `EDB1` encoder/decoder (`edb_bin_encode_frame`, `edb_bin_decode_response`), HTTP/1.1 Keep-Alive router, Basic Auth. |
| `src/reactor.h`, `src/reactor_win.c`, `src/reactor_linux.c` | Slab-pooled `edb_conn_t` lifecycle, atomic `refcount`, Windows IOCP (`WSARecv`/`WSASend` + `PostQueuedCompletionStatus`), Linux `epoll` (`EPOLLET` + `SO_REUSEPORT` + `eventfd`), RX/TX handoff. |
| `src/server.h`, `src/server.c` | `edb_server_t`, sharded work-stealing queues (`edb_work_queue_t`), worker threads, maintenance thread (bg flush, WAL checkpoint, idle reaper, metrics log), graceful shutdown. |
| `src/cli.c`, `src/bench.c`, `src/main.c` | Binary `EDB1` interactive/one-shot CLI, multi-threaded TCP & `--embedded` benchmark runner, CLI subcommand dispatcher & startup banner. |
| `tests/test_suite.py` | End-to-end Python test suite: SQL/protocols, crash recovery (`proc.kill()`), config/auth, 200-client stress test, embedded & TCP IOCP benchmarks. |
| `scripts/gen_docs_data.py` | Parses `g_specs[]` from `src/config.c` to regenerate `docs/api/config-schema.json`, `docs/config-data.js`, `docs/llms-full.txt`, and mirrors `AGENTS*.md` into `docs/`. |

## 3. Critical Portability & Concurrency Invariants

### Portability Rules (MUST follow on every edit)
1. **Windows header order**: NEVER include `<windows.h>` before `<winsock2.h>` and `<ws2tcpip.h>`. Always include `pal.h` or define `WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN` and include `<winsock2.h>` first.
2. **No `<stdatomic.h>`**: MSVC C11 support for `<stdatomic.h>` varies by SDK; always use `edb_atomic_i64`, `edb_atomic_u64`, `edb_atomic_u32` from `src/pal.h`.
3. **No GCC extensions**: Avoid VLAs, `typeof`, statement expressions, and zero-length `[0]` arrays (use `[1]` or pointer allocations).
4. **Linux feature macro**: Keep `#define _GNU_SOURCE` in `pal_linux.c`, `reactor_linux.c`, `CMakeLists.txt`, and `Makefile` (needed for `accept4`, `qsort_r`, `sigaction`, `pthread_rwlock_t`).
5. **Portable `qsort`**: `sql_exec.c` uses `qsort_s(arr, n, sz, cmp, ctx)` on Windows (`cmp(ctx, a, b)`) and `qsort_r(arr, n, sz, cmp, ctx)` on Linux (`cmp(a, b, ctx)`).

### Concurrency & Memory-Safety Invariants
1. **Connection Reference Counting**: Every `edb_conn_t` starts with `refcount = 1` (owned by the open socket). Each in-flight `WSARecv`, `WSASend`, `IOCP_OP_KICK_SEND`, epoll event dispatch, or worker queue item MUST retain via `edb_reactor_conn_retain()` before queuing and release via `edb_reactor_conn_release()`. `free_conn_final()` runs strictly when `refcount == 0` and invokes `on_close` (`edb_session_destroy`) before returning the slot to `free_list`.
2. **Double-Buffered IOCP Send (`reactor_win.c`)**: Workers append to `ctx->tx_buf` under `ctx->io_mu`. `try_start_send_locked()` swaps `ctx->tx_buf` into `ctx->tx_active` ONLY when `ctx->send_pending == false`. **Never** `realloc` `ctx->tx_active` while `WSASend` is in flight.
3. **Lock Ordering (`io_mu` vs `pool_mu` vs `close_conn_socket`)**:
   - In `alloc_conn()`: pop from `free_list` under `pool_mu`, unlock `pool_mu`, initialize ALL fields (including `last_active_ms = edb_now_ms()`), then re-acquire `pool_mu` to insert into `active_head`. Otherwise `edb_reactor_reap_idle()` can observe `last_active_ms == 0`.
   - In `reactor_win.c` (`try_start_send_locked`) and `reactor_linux.c` (`flush_tx_locked`): never call `close_conn_socket()` while holding `ctx->io_mu`; return `bool need_close` and call `close_conn_socket()` after unlocking `ctx->io_mu`.
4. **Per-Connection FIFO Ordering & Work Stealing (`server.c`)**:
   - `conn->worker_busy` (CAS `0 -> 1`) guarantees at most one worker executes requests for a given connection at a time, preserving strict pipelined response order.
   - `srv->queue_shards` is clamped to `<= srv->worker_count`, and shard selection uses `% srv->queue_shards`.
   - `work_queue_pop()` uses a single `edb_cond_timedwait_ms(..., 5)` (`if`, NOT `while`) so idle workers return promptly and steal from busy shards.
5. **GROUP BY & ORDER BY Aliases (`sql_exec.c`)**:
   - `group_t` stores `const edb_row_t *const **tuples` (full joined tuple pointers across all `FROM`/`JOIN` sources), and `eval_aggregate()` updates all `ctx->sources[s].row` entries per tuple.
   - `ORDER BY` resolves bare `EXPR_IDENT` against `projs[p].name` (SELECT column aliases) before falling back to table column lookup.
6. **Cache Invalidation (`sql_exec.c`)**:
   - Result cache entries store `schema_version` + `(table_id, table->version)` snapshots + `created_ms`. Bypassed when `sess->txn != NULL`, `param_count > 0`, or `NOW()` is present.

---

## 4. Wire Protocols (Multiplexed on Port `7432`)

First-byte detection in `edb_protocol_process()` (`src/protocol.c`):
- `0x45` (`'E'`): **Binary `EDB1`** (if `network.enable_binary_protocol = true`)
- `GET `, `POST`, `HEAD`, `PUT `, `DELE`, `OPTI`: **HTTP/1.1 JSON** (if `network.enable_http = true`)
- Anything else: **Text Line Protocol** (if `network.enable_text_protocol = true`)

### Binary Protocol (`EDB1`) — Little-Endian
- **Request Frame (8-byte header + payload)**:
  - `[0]` `0x45` (`'E'`), `[1]` `op`, `[2..3]` `flags` (`u16`), `[4..7]` `len` (`u32`), `[8..8+len)` `payload`.
  - Opcodes: `0x01 PING`, `0x02 QUERY` (UTF-8 SQL), `0x03 BATCH` (`;`-delimited SQL), `0x04 AUTH` (`[u16 ulen][user][u16 plen][pass]`), `0x05 PREPARE`, `0x06 EXEC`.
- **Response Frame (8-byte header + payload)**:
  - `[0]` `0x52` (`'R'`), `[1]` `status` (`edb_status_t`), `[2..3]` `flags` (`bit 0 = is_select_like`, `bit 1 = from_cache`), `[4..7]` `len` (`u32`).
  - `PING` body: `"PONG"` (4 bytes).
  - Query body: `[u64 rows_affected][u64 last_insert_id][u64 elapsed_us]`, then:
    - If `status != 0`: `[u16 err_len][err_msg]`.
    - Else if `is_select_like`: `[u32 col_count][u32 row_count]`, per-col `[u16 name_len][name][u8 type]`, per-cell `[u8 val_type][value]`.
  - Value types: `0=NULL`, `1=INT(i64)`, `2=REAL(f64)`, `3=TEXT(u32 len + bytes)`, `4=BOOL(u8)`, `5=BLOB(u32 len + bytes)`, `6=TIMESTAMP(i64)`.
  - Status codes: `0=OK`, `1=SYNTAX`, `2=NOT_FOUND`, `3=EXISTS`, `4=CONSTRAINT`, `5=IO`, `6=OOM`, `7=AUTH`, `8=OVERLOAD`, `9=INVALID`, `10=TXN`, `11=READONLY`, `12=INTERNAL`.

### HTTP/1.1 JSON Endpoints
- `GET /health` -> `{"status":"ok","version":"1.0.0","node":"...","uptime_sec":N}` (exempt from auth)
- `GET /metrics` -> JSON counters + `latency_p50_us`, `latency_p95_us`, `latency_p99_us`
- `GET /config` -> JSON map of all 92 `section.key` entries (`admin_password` masked)
- `POST /query` -> Raw SQL body or `{"sql":"..."}` -> `{"ok":true,"rows_affected":...,"columns":[...],"rows":[[...]]}`
- `POST /batch` -> `;`-delimited SQL -> JSON array `[...]`
- Auth: `Authorization: Basic base64(user:password)` when `security.auth_enabled = true`.

---

## 5. Configuration System (92 Parameters, 11 Sections)

Precedence (lowest to highest):
1. Built-in auto-tuned defaults (`edb_config_defaults`)
2. INI file (`-c path` or `./elliottdb.conf` in CWD)
3. Env vars `ELLIOTTDB_<SECTION>_<KEY>` (uppercased, e.g. `ELLIOTTDB_SERVER_PORT=8000`)
4. CLI flags (`--<section>.<key>=<value>`, or shortcuts `-H`, `-p`, `-d`, `-t`, `-c`, `--memory`, `--no-banner`)
5. Runtime SQL `SET section.key = value` (for mutable keys)

Sections: `[server]`, `[network]`, `[concurrency]`, `[storage]`, `[buffer_pool]`, `[wal]`, `[query]`, `[index]`, `[security]`, `[logging]`, `[metrics]`.
Full machine-readable schema: [`docs/api/config-schema.json`](docs/api/config-schema.json).

---

## 6. Build, Test & Maintenance Commands

```bat
:: Windows static single binary (MSVC /O2 /MT /W4)
build.bat
:: Verify zero non-OS DLL dependencies
dumpbin /dependents build\elliottdb.exe
:: Run full end-to-end test & benchmark suite
python tests\test_suite.py
```

```bash
# Linux single binary
make            # or: make static / ./build.sh --static
# CMake (Windows or Linux)
cmake -B build_cmake -G Ninja && cmake --build build_cmake
```

Whenever modifying `g_specs[]` in `src/config.c` or updating documentation, regenerate the site schema and agent bundles:
```bash
python scripts/gen_docs_data.py
```
